title: Angular frequency and period
description: Essential: Correctly states ω = √[G(M₁+M₂)/|r₂−r₁|³] and T = 2π√[|r₂−r₁|³/(G(M₁+M₂))].

title: Mass ratio α
description: Essential: Correctly defines α = M₂/(M₁+M₂) from the given position definitions.

title: Distance expressions
description: Essential: Correctly writes ρ₁ = √[(x+αR)² + y²] and ρ₂ = √[(x−(1−α)R)² + y²].

title: Vector acceleration in rotating frame
description: Important: Derives or states the total acceleration as sum of gravitational, centrifugal, and Coriolis terms.

title: Equations in terms of U
description: Important: Correctly expresses d²x/dt² = 2ω(dy/dt) − ∂U/∂x and d²y/dt² = −2ω(dx/dt) − ∂U/∂y.

title: Constant of motion
description: Essential: Identifies the conserved quantity as −2U − v² = constant.

title: Sign errors in accelerations
description: Pitfall: Incorrect sign for Coriolis term (e.g., +2ω×v instead of −2ω×v) or misplacement in component equations.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Checks dimensional consistency of derived expressions for ω, T, and accelerations.

title: Interpretation of U
description: Optional: Recognizes U as an effective potential combining gravitational and centrifugal parts.
